description: Returns the inflation of Georgia for one month, in percent: annual (to the same month of the previous year), monthly (to the previous month), the 12 month average, and core inflation. For the whole country, a city, and a price group. The default is the newest published month. Data from the consumer price index of Geostat.

group.description: The price group: total, food, alcohol_tobacco, clothing, housing, furnishings, health, transport, communication, recreation, education, restaurants, or miscellaneous. The default is total.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

month.description: The month, YYYY-MM. The default is the newest published month.

region.description: georgia, tbilisi, kutaisi, batumi, gori, telavi, or zugdidi. The default is georgia.

name: stats_get_inflation

annual.description: The change of prices since the same month of the previous year, in percent. Null when not published.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the indices, RFC 3339.

average.description: The change of the average prices of the last 12 months over the 12 months before, in percent. Published for the group total only.

core.description: The core inflation, in percent. Published for georgia and the group total only.

name.description: The name in the language of the request.

monthly.description: The change of prices since the previous month, in percent. Null when not published.

name.description: The name in the language of the request.

source.description: The source of the data: Geostat.

stale.description: True when Geostat did not answer and the server returns indices it read before.

tables.description: The tables of Geostat that the answer reads, with their update dates.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the table, RFC 3339.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the table, each with its values in the order of Geostat.

code.description: The code of the dimension, for a selection.
The code of the value, for a selection.

folder.description: The folder path of the table, from the subject down, as in the code. The same in both languages.

source.description: The source of the data: Geostat.

stale.description: True when Geostat did not answer and the server returns a table it read before.

title.description: The title of the table. It often names the unit.

updated.description: The date on which Geostat last changed the table, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: Get the inflation of Georgia
